entries.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
entries.translation: I seek refuge in God from Satan the Accursed.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
entries.translation: Q1:1 In the Name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَتَّى تَرْضَى، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إِذَا رَضِيتَ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ بَعْدَ رِضَاكَ
entries.translation: God, Yours is all praise until You are pleased, and Yours is all praise when You are pleased, and Yours is all praise after You are pleased.

entries.arabic: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَالَّذِي نَقُولُ وَخَيْرًا مِمَّا نَقُولُ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَالَّذِي تَقُولُ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
entries.translation: And Yours is all praise as we say and better than what we say, and Yours is all praise as You say, and Yours is all praise in every circumstance.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
entries.translation: God, we ask You for guidance, piety, temperance, and sufficiency.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ الْجَمِيلِ (×2)
entries.translation: God, conceal us in Your beautiful veil.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ الدَّائِمَةَ فِي الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
entries.translation: God, we ask You for pardon, well-being, and everlasting sufficiency in matters of religion, this life, and the next life.

entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
entries.translation: Q2:201 Our Lord, give us what is good in this life and what is good in the next life, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
entries.translation: Q3:8 Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to swerve after You have guided us, and bestow upon us from Your Presence mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
entries.translation: Q18:10 Our Lord, give us from Your Presence mercy, and prepare for us in our affair guidance.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَا تَفْضَحْنَا بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
entries.translation: God, Our Lord, do not expose us before Your servants in this life or the next.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ، بِجَاهِ أَسْمَاءِ اللهِ وَصِفَاتِ اللهِ وَأَنْبِيَاءِ اللهِ وَرُسُلِ اللهِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللهِ
entries.translation: God, O God, O God, O God, O God! By the rank of God's names, God's attributes, God's prophets, God's messengers, and the righteous amongst God's servants:

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْضِ حَوَائِجَنَا ظَاهِرًا وَبَاطِنًا
entries.translation: God, fulfill our needs, inwardly and outwardly.

entries.arabic: نَصْرٌ مِّنَ اللهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.translation: Q61:13 Help from God and imminent victory: so give glad tidings to the believers!

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَرِنَا الْحَقَّ حَقًّا وَارْزُقْنَا اتِّبَاعَهُ، وَأَرِنَا الْبَاطِلَ بَاطِلًا وَارْزُقْنَا اجْتِنَابَهُ
entries.translation: God, show us truth as truth and provide us with adherence to it, and show us falsehood as falsehood and provide us with avoidance of it.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا حُسْنَ الْخَاتِمَةِ (×2)
entries.translation: God, provide us with a beautiful end.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
entries.translation: God, assist us in remembering You, being grateful to You, and beautifully worshipping You.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا عَالِمَ السِّرِّ مِنَّا، لَا تَهْتِكِ السِّتْرَ عَنَّا، وَعَافِنَا وَاعْفُ عَنَّا، وَكُنْ لَنَا حَيْثُ كُنَّا
entries.translation: God, You who know the secrets we conceal! Do not rend the veil and expose us. Grant us well-being, pardon us, and be on our side wherever we be.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَيْقِظْ قُلُوبَنَا لَكَ، وَنَبِّهْنَا مِنَ الْغَفْلَةِ عَنْكَ (×2)
entries.translation: God, awaken our hearts to You, and rouse us from our heedlessness of You.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ كَلَامِنَا لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللهِ، صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.translation: God, make the last of our words: "There is no god but God; Muhammad is the Messenger of God." (God extol him and envelop him in perfect peace!)

entries.arabic: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ، يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
entries.translation: Q33:56 God and His angels extol the Prophet. O you who believe! Extol him and salute him with a greeting of peace.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَمَالِ اللهِ كَمَا يَلِيقُ بِكَمَالِهِ
entries.translation: God, extol our noble lord Muhammad, envelop him in perfect peace, and bless him, and do likewise with his folk — a number of times commensurate with His perfection, as befits His perfection.

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
entries.translation: Q37:180–182 Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of might, beyond what they describe. Peace be upon the messengers. All praise is for God, Lord of the worlds.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَمَالِ اللهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيقُ بِكَمَالِهِ (×10)
entries.translation: God, extol, grant perfect peace, and bless our noble Master Muhammad and the Family of our noble Master Muhammad, according to the number of all of the Perfections of God, and as is befitting of God's Perfection.

entries.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ (×10)
entries.translation: I seek the forgiveness of God in His Glory.

entries.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ (×10)
entries.translation: There is no god but God.

entries.arabic: الَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
entries.translation: Q3:173 Those to whom the people said, “The people have gathered against you, so fear them.” And they replied, “God is all we need. What an excellent guardian is God.”

entries.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ (×50)
entries.translation: God is all we need. What an excellent Guardian is God.

entries.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا
entries.translation: Q71:10–12 [Noah] said [to the disbelievers]: “Seek forgiveness from your Lord; truly He is all-Forgiving. Then He will send down upon you abundant rainfall from heaven, and He will extend His mighty support unto you in wealth and progeny, providing you with gardens and rivers.”

entries.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ (×50)
entries.translation: I ask the forgiveness of God in His glory.

entries.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
entries.translation: Indeed, God is All-Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

entries.arabic: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
entries.translation: Q47:19 And so know that there is no god but God.

entries.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ (×20)
entries.translation: There is no God but God, the King, the Real, the Manifestly Apparent.

entries.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ، يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
entries.translation: Q33:56 Truly, God and His Angels extol the Prophet. You who believe, extol him and invoke upon him blessings of perfect peace.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ (×20)
entries.translation: God, extol our noble Master Muhammad, his Family, and his Companions, and encompass them in perfect peace.

entries.arabic: يَا هَادِي (×10)
entries.translation: Oh God the Guide!

entries.arabic: أَنْتَ الْهَادِي أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ لَيْسَ الْهَادِي إِلَّا اللهُ (×10)
entries.translation: You God are the Guide. You God are the Absolutely Real. There is no Guide but God.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
entries.translation: Q1:1–7 In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Praise be to God, Lord of all the worlds, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful, Complete Possessor of the Day of Judgement: You alone do we worship, and You alone do we seek for help. Guide us along the Straight Way, the Way of those whom You have blessed, not the Way of those who have incurred wrath, nor of those who have gone astray.

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
entries.translation: Q37:180–182 Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might and Majesty, above all that they falsely ascribe to Him. Peace be upon the Message-Bearers, and praise be to God, Lord of all the worlds.

entries.arabic: هَذَا حِزْبُ الْقُطْبِ الْإِمَامِ النَّوَوِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يُقْرَأُ صَبَاحًا وَمَسَاءً
entries.translation: This is the litany of the Pole (Quṭb), Imam al-Nawawī, may God be pleased with him. It is recited morning and evening.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
entries.translation: In the Name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي، وَعَلَى دِينِي، وَعَلَى أَهْلِي، وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي، وَعَلَى مَالِي، وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي، وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ، وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ أَلْفَ بِسْمِ اللهِ
entries.translation: In the Name of God; God is Greater, God is Greater. I invoke it over myself, my religion, my family, my children, my wealth, my companions, their religion, and their wealth — a thousand times, “In the Name of God.”

entries.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي، وَعَلَى دِينِي، وَعَلَى أَهْلِي، وَعَلَى إِخْوَانِي، وَعَلَى مَالِي، وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي، وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ، وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ أَلْفَ بِسْمِ اللهِ
entries.translation: God is Greater, God is Greater. I invoke it over myself, my religion, my family, my brothers, my wealth, my companions, their religion, and their wealth — a thousand times, “In the Name of God.”

entries.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَقُولُ عَلَى نَفْسِي، وَعَلَى دِينِي، وَعَلَى أَهْلِي، وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي، وَعَلَى مَالِي، وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِي، وَعَلَى أَدْيَانِهِمْ، وَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ أَلْفَ أَلْفَ أَلْفَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: God is Greater. I invoke it over myself, my religion, my family, my children, my wealth, my companions, their religion, and their wealth — a thousand thousand thousand times. There is no power and no strength except by God, the Most High, the Magnificent.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ، وَمِنَ اللهِ، وَإِلَى اللهِ، وَعَلَى اللهِ، وَفِي اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
entries.translation: In the Name of God, and by God, and from God, and to God, and upon God, and in God; there is no power and no strength except by God.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ عَلَى دِينِي، وَعَلَى نَفْسِي، وَعَلَى أَوْلَادِي، بِسْمِ اللهِ عَلَى مَالِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِي، بِسْمِ اللهِ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعْطَانِيهِ رَبِّي، بِسْمِ اللهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: In the Name of God over my religion, over myself, over my children; in the Name of God over my wealth and my family; in the Name of God over everything my Lord has given me; in the Name of God, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the seven earths, and Lord of the Magnificent Throne.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
entries.translation: In the Name of God, with whose Name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، لَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللهِ أَفْتَتِحُ وَبِهِ أَخْتَتِمُ
entries.translation: In the Name of God, the best of Names — neither on earth nor in heaven is there its like. With the Name of God I begin, and with it I conclude.

entries.arabic: اللهُ اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا، اللهُ اللهُ اللهُ، اللهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، اللهُ أَعَزُّ وَأَجَلُّ وَأَكْبَرُ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ
entries.translation: God, God, God is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him. God, God, God — God, there is no god but God. God is Mightier, more Majestic, and Greater than whatever I fear or am wary of.

entries.arabic: بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَيْرِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ رَبِّي وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ، وَبِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَحْتَرِزُ مِنْهُمْ، وَبِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ، وَبِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَدْرَأُ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ
entries.translation: By You, God, I seek refuge from the evil of myself, from the evil of others, and from the evil of what my Lord has created, scattered abroad, and brought into being. By You, God, I guard myself from them. By You, God, I seek refuge from their evils. By You, God, I repel harm at their very throats.

entries.arabic: وَأُقَدِّمُ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
entries.translation: And I set before myself: “In the Name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving” — three times.

entries.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ، اللهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
entries.translation: Q112:1–4 Say: He is God, One. God, the Everlasting Refuge. He begets not, nor was He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.

entries.arabic: وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ عَنْ يَمِينِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ عَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ أَمَامِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ خَلْفِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ فَوْقِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ تَحْتِي، وَمِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ مُحِيطٌ بِي
entries.translation: And the like of that to my right, and the like of that to my left, and the like of that before me, and the like of that behind me, and the like of that above me, and the like of that beneath me, and the like of that encompassing me on every side.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لِي وَلَهُمْ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ بِخَيْرِكَ الَّذِي لَا يَمْلِكُهُ غَيْرُكَ
entries.translation: God, I ask You for myself and for them from Your good, by Your good which none possesses but You.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي وَإِيَّاهُمْ فِي عِبَادِكَ وَعِيَاذِكَ وَعِيَالِكَ وَجِوَارِكَ وَأَمَانَتِكَ وَحِزْبِكَ وَحِرْزِكَ، وَكَنَفِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَسُلْطَانٍ، وَإِنْسٍ وَجَانٍّ، وَبَاغٍ وَحَاسِدٍ، وَسَبُعٍ وَعَقْرَبٍ وَحَيَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
entries.translation: God, place me and them among Your servants, under Your protection, in Your care, in Your neighborly shelter, in Your trust, in Your company, and in Your safekeeping — sheltered from every devil and tyrant, every human and jinn, every oppressor and envier, every predator, scorpion, and serpent, and from every creature whose forelock You hold. [Q11:56] Truly my Lord is upon a straight path.

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْمَرْبُوبِينَ، حَسْبِيَ الْخَالِقُ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ، حَسْبِيَ الرَّازِقُ مِنَ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ، حَسْبِيَ السَّاتِرُ مِنَ الْمَسْتُورِينَ
entries.translation: God, my Lord, suffices me among those who have a lord; the Creator suffices me among the created; the Provider suffices me among the provided-for; the Concealer suffices me among the concealed.

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ النَّاصِرُ مِنَ الْمَنْصُورِينَ، حَسْبِيَ الْقَاهِرُ مِنَ الْمَقْهُورِينَ، حَسْبِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ حَسْبِي، حَسْبِيَ مَن لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِي، حَسْبِيَ اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ، حَسْبِيَ اللهُ مِن جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ
entries.translation: The Helper suffices me among the helped; the Overpowering suffices me among the overpowered. He who is truly my sufficiency suffices me; He who has never ceased to be my sufficiency suffices me. God suffices me, and how excellent a Guardian is He! God suffices me against all of His creation.

entries.arabic: إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ
entries.translation: Q7:196 Truly my Protector is God, who has revealed the Book, and He is the Protector of the righteous.

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: Q9:129 God is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust, and He is Lord of the Magnificent Throne.

entries.arabic: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا، وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا، وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَحْدَهُ وَلَّوْا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمْ نُفُورًا
entries.translation: Q17:45–46 And when you recite the Qur’an, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil. And We place coverings upon their hearts, lest they understand it, and in their ears, deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’an, they turn their backs in aversion.

entries.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ (×7)
entries.translation: Q9:129 But if they turn away, say: “God is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust, and He is Lord of the Magnificent Throne.”

entries.arabic: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: There is no power and no strength except by God, the Most High, the Magnificent.

entries.arabic: خَبَّأْتُ نَفْسِي فِي خَزَائِنِ اللهِ، أَقْفَالُهَا ثِقَتِي بِاللهِ، مَفَاتِحُهَا لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ، أُدَافِعُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَن نَّفْسِي مَا أُطِيقُ وَمَا لَا أُطِيقُ
entries.translation: I have hidden myself away in the treasuries of God, whose locks are my trust in God, and whose keys are “there is no strength except by God.” By You, God, I fend off from myself what I have strength for and what I have no strength for.

entries.arabic: لَا طَاقَةَ لِمَخْلُوقٍ مَعَ قُدْرَةِ الْخَالِقِ
entries.translation: No created being has any power in the face of the power of the Creator.

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
entries.translation: God is sufficient for me, and how excellent a Guardian is He.

entries.arabic: تَمَّ حِزْبُ الْقُطْبِ الْإِمَامِ النَّوَوِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ
entries.translation: Here ends the litany of the Pole, Imam al-Nawawī, may God be pleased with him.

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
entries.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.' (112:1–4) (3x)

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
entries.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.' (113:1–5) (3x)

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
entries.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.' (114:1–6) (3x)

entries.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
entries.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me. (23:97–98) (3x)

entries.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
entries.translation: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned? So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne. And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed. And say, 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.' (23:115–118)

entries.arabic: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
entries.translation: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth, and [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out. (30:17–19)

entries.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
entries.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan. (3x)

entries.arabic: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهۥ خَـٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
entries.translation: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought. He is Allah, besides whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, besides whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. (59:21–24)

entries.arabic: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
entries.translation: Peace upon Noah among all the worlds. Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. Indeed, he was of Our believing servants. (37:79–81)

entries.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
entries.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (3x)

entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
entries.translation: In the Name of Allah, by whose Name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (3x)

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ (أَمْسَيْتُ) مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ فَأَتْمِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
entries.translation: O Allah, I have entered this morning (evening) in Your blessing, and well-being, and protection. So complete Your blessing upon me, Your well-being, and Your protection, in this world and in the Hereafter. (3x)

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ (أَمْسَيْتُ) أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
entries.translation: O Allah, I have entered this morning (evening) bearing witness before You, and I call to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah - there is no deity except You, You are alone, without partner. And that our master Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger. (4x)

entries.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ حَمْدًا يُوَافِي نِعَمَهُ وَيُكَافِئُ مَزِيدَهُ
entries.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, with praise that is commensurate with His blessings and corresponds to their increase. (3x)

entries.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَكَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَاسْتَمْسَكْتُ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى لَا انفِصَامَ لَهَا وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
entries.translation: I believe in Allah, the Magnificent, and I reject false objects of worship (al-jibt) and all rebellious false deities and forces of misguidance (al-taghut), and I hold firmly to the firmest handhold which never breaks. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing. (3x)

entries.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا وَرَسُولًا
entries.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with our master Muhammad - may Allah send His blessings upon him and his family and grant him peace - as my prophet and messenger. (3x)

entries.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne. (9:129) (7x)

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
entries.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, and his companions, and grant him peace. (10x)

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الْخَيْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الشَّرِّ
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the sudden coming of good, and I seek refuge in You from the sudden coming of evil.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
entries.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I remain upon Your covenant and promise as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. Upon You I rely, and You are the Lord of the Great Throne.

entries.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
entries.translation: What Allah wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.

entries.arabic: أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
entries.translation: I know that Allah is capable of all things, and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
entries.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of every creature - You are the One who holds it by its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is upon a straight path.

entries.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ وَمِنْ عَذَابِكَ أَسْتَجِيرُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي وَلَا إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
entries.translation: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek rescue. From Your punishment I seek protection. Set right for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself or to any of Your creation for the blink of an eye.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
entries.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, I seek refuge in You from weakness and laziness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ الدَّائِمَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon, well-being, and lasting protection in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي
entries.translation: O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
entries.translation: O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness lest I be taken unexpectedly from beneath me.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنْتَ تَهْدِينِي وَأَنْتَ تُطْعِمُنِي وَأَنْتَ تَسْقِينِي وَأَنْتَ تُمِيتُنِي وَأَنْتَ تُحْيِينِي وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
entries.translation: O Allah, You created me, and You guide me. You feed me, and You give me drink. You cause me to die, and You give me life. And You are over all things powerful.

entries.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا (أَمْسَيْنَا) عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
entries.translation: We have entered the morning (evening) upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may Allah send prayers upon him and his family and grant him peace, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining toward truth as a Muslim, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَعَلَيْكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
entries.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and upon You we rely, and to You is the resurrection.

entries.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا (أَمْسَيْنَا) وَأَصْبَحَ (وَأَمْسَى) الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
entries.translation: We have entered the morning (evening), and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its success, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ وَخَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا قَبْلَهُ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, the good that is within it, the good that comes before it, and the good that comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day, the evil that is within it, the evil that comes before it, and the evil that comes after it.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ (أَمْسَى) بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
entries.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this morning (evening), or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise, and for You is all thanks for that.

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
entries.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, by the number of His creation, by His own pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words. (3x)

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent, and praise be to Him, by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words. (3x)

entries.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
entries.translation: Glory be to Allah equal to the number of what He has created in the sky, glory be to Allah equal to the number of what He has created on the earth, glory be to Allah by the number of what is between that, glory be to Allah by the number of what He will create.

entries.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
entries.translation: Praise be to Allah equal to the number of what He has created in the sky, praise be to Allah equal to the number of what He has created on the earth, praise be to Allah by the number of what lies between that, praise be to Allah by the number of what He will create.

entries.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
entries.translation: There is no deity except Allah equal to the number of what He has created in the sky, there is no deity except Allah equal to the number of what He has created on the earth, there is no deity except Allah by the number of what lies between that, there is no deity except Allah by the number of what He will create.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
entries.translation: Allah is the greatest equal to the number of what He has created in the sky, Allah is the greatest equal to the number of what He has created on the earth, Allah is the greatest by the number of what lies between that, Allah is the greatest by the number of what He will create.

entries.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
entries.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great, equal to the number of what He has created in the sky, there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great, equal to the number of what He has created on the earth, there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great, by the number of what lies between that, there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great, by the number of what He will create.

entries.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
entries.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is capable of all things - by the number of every atom, a thousand times. (3x)

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِفْتَاحِ بَابِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِ اللَّهِ صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا دَائِمَيْنِ بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
entries.translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the key to the door of Allah's mercy, by the number of all that is in Allah's knowledge, blessings and peace that are continuous with the continuity of Allah's dominion, and upon his family and companions by the number of every atom, a thousand times. (3x)
